### workspace dir --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace dir [--name WS] [project]

Print the root directory of a workspace project. With no project, the
workspace the current directory is in (not_in_workspace outside any).

        --name NAME                  The workspace (default: the one detected from the current directory)

Examples:
  workspace dir    # the root of the workspace you are in
  workspace dir api    # where the api project lives, from anywhere
  workspace dir api | pbcopy    # put its path on the clipboard
  workspace dir --name api.worktree-login    # the checkout of one worktree workspace
--- stderr
--- end
